topic: Explain what's going on with the Hormuz strait
hook: Explain what's going on with the Hormuz strait
script:
Timed VO · youtube · one_time_short_episode · centered_independent

ACT 1
00:00:00–00:08:00
In 2018, on the receipt: The United States withdrew from the JCPOA, tightening the Iran file around the Gulf. Grounded. Independent on that row is missing. [jcpoa-2018] Hold on this card. Do not add a fact that is not on the row.

00:08:00–00:16:00
In 2018-2024, on the receipt: A large share of seaborne oil still transits the Strait of Hormuz. Grounded. Propaganda yes, issuer OPEC. Not independent. [hormuz-share] Hold on this card. Do not add a fact that is not on the row.

ACT 2
00:16:00–00:24:00
In 2023-2024, on the receipt: Any Hormuz scare means oil crashes the world overnight. Mainstream, not a source. Source lean missing. [oil-panic] Hold on this card. Do not add a fact that is not on the row.

00:24:00–00:32:00
In 2018-2024, on the receipt: Producer states treat an open Hormuz as an oil-market given. Mainstream, not a source. Source lean industry. [producer-frame] Hold on this card. Do not add a fact that is not on the row.

ACT 3
00:32:00–00:40:00
In decade, on the receipt: Hormuz has already been mined shut under a hidden navy treaty. Tagged fringe, never sold as fact. [secret-closure] Hold on this card. Do not add a fact that is not on the row.

00:40:00–00:43:00
On the receipt: Causal link jcpoa-2018 to oil-panic is missing. The 2018 JCPOA exit caused the 2023-2024 Hormuz panic. Parallel did not source this. Not invented. [jcpoa-2018] [oil-panic]
